This matters because many AI agent workflows rely on repeated classification and routing decisions. Generating extra tokens adds work when the workflow only needs a label, score, route, or yes/no answer. Jev fits tasks such as sorting inputs into categories, choosing which workflow handles a request, ranking or scoring an item, and detecting spam, risk, intent, urgency, topic, or sentiment. The simple rule: use a general LLM when you need language. Use Jev when you need probabilities for a focused classification or routing decision. What is the Jev AI model?
